quarterly_data.quarter: Skyworks Solutions press release: Skyworks Si829x Isolated Safety Gate Driver Qualified and (10-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Skyworks' Si829x isolated safety gate driver with ProVCD technology (supports both SiC FETs and IGBTs, for inverter architectures from automotive drivetrains to eVTOL systems) has completed AEC-Q100 automotive qualification and is ready for advanced prototyping; samples, tools, user guides and application notes are available now, along with two evaluation board kits, GUI software and complex device driver (CDD) software. The release positions it for customer evaluation through pre-production prototypes - sampling, not production shipments.
quarterly_data.figure: AEC-Q100 qualification completed; samples available now; two evaluation board kits

quarterly_data.quarter: Skyworks Solutions press release: Skyworks Si829x Isolated Safety Gate Driver Qualified and (10-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Si829x specs per the release: designed to support customer functional safety system designs rated up to ASIL D (subject to system-level implementation and validation); ProVCD, Skyworks' second-generation variable current drive, gives precise 15 Amp 3-phase turn-on and turn-off current waveform control and switching-loss reductions of up to 44% in Skyworks testing compared with voltage-mode gate drive. Skyworks VP of product line management Mario Battello: the ProVCD platform is meant to standardize inverter designs for EVs, eVTOL and eAgriculture and accelerate development for high power motor applications like datacenter cooling and AI power supplies.
quarterly_data.figure: 15 Amp 3-phase current waveform control; switching-loss reductions of up to 44% in Skyworks testing; up to ASIL D
